appearance_facts.fact: A single purple line connects four circular data points, rising continuously from the bottom-left to the top-right of the plot area.
The first data point is positioned lowest on the vertical axis, aligning horizontally with the 5.5% grid line.
The second data point is positioned higher than the 2017 point, aligning horizontally between the 6.0% and 6.5% grid lines.
The third data point is positioned higher than the 2018 point, aligning horizontally slightly above the 7.0% grid line.
The fourth and final data point is positioned highest on the vertical axis, aligning horizontally with the 8.0% grid line.
The slope of the line is positive and appears consistent across the visible segments from 2017 to 2020.
